description: Get a deliverability health snapshot for the active tenant: total suppressed emails (hard bounces + complaints + manual unsubscribes), 30-day trend, and breakdown by suppression reason. Call this when the user asks about list health, unsubscribe rates, or bounce issues. A suppression rate above 2% indicates deliverability risk — surface this as a warning before scheduling a large campaign.
name: nevent_get_suppressions_summary
